records.jp: ごちそうさまでした！
records.en_original: That was amazing!
records.en_auxiliary: That was amazing!
records.en: That was amazing!

records.jp: みんな、ありがとね。<CR>いろいろしてくれて
records.en_original: Thanks, everyone. I really appreciate everything.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, everyone. I really appreciate everything.
records.en: Thanks, everyone. I really appreciate everything.

records.jp: ううん、気にしないで。<CR>気軽にやってこ、気軽に
records.en_original: Don't worry about it! Just take it easy!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about it! Just take it easy!
records.en: Don't worry about it! Just take it easy!

records.jp: そうだ、こころ。陽桜莉さんについて教えてくれない？<CR>知り合いだったんだよね？
records.en_original: Oh, that reminds me! Kokoro, could you tell us about Hiori? You two knew each other before, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, that reminds me! Kokoro, could you tell us about Hiori? You two knew each other before, right?
records.en: Oh, that reminds me! Kokoro, could you tell us about Hiori-san? You two knew each other before, right?

records.jp: うん。同じAASAの仲間だったんだ
records.en_original: Yeah. We were both part of AASA.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. We were both part of AASA.
records.en: Yeah. We were both part of AASA.

records.jp: とはいっても、みんな一緒に活動している<CR>わけじゃないから、たまに会うくらいだったかな
records.en_original: We didn't actually work together, but we'd occasionally bump into each other.
records.en_auxiliary: We didn't actually work together, but we'd occasionally bump into each other.
records.en: We didn't actually work together, but we'd occasionally bump into each other.

records.jp: 陽桜莉ちゃんには美弦ちゃんっていうお姉さんがいて、<CR>今探してるのも美弦ちゃんのことだと思うのです
records.en_original: Hiori has an older sister named Mio. She's the one Hiori is looking for.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori has an older sister named Mio. She's the one Hiori is looking for.
records.en: Hiori-chan has an older sister named Mio-chan,<CR>and I think Mio-chan is the one she's looking for.

records.jp: 平原美弦さん……ね
records.en_original: Mio Hirahara, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio Hirahara, huh...
records.en: Hirahara Mio-san, huh...

records.jp: どう、陽桜莉さん？<CR>何か、引っかかることとかないかな？
records.en_original: Well, Hiori? Remember anything?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, Hiori? Remember anything?
records.en: Well, Hiori-san? Remember anything?

records.jp: う～ん、覚えてるような、<CR>覚えてないような……
records.en_original: Hmm... Kind of? No? I don't know...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Kind of? No? I don't know...
records.en: Hmm... Kind of? No? I don't know...

records.jp: うむむ、そっか……
records.en_original: Hmm... That's too bad...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... That's too bad...
records.en: Hmm... That's too bad...

records.jp: じゃあ、カレーは？
records.en_original: What about the curry?
records.en_auxiliary: What about the curry?
records.en: What about the curry?

records.jp: カレー？
records.en_original: What about it?
records.en_auxiliary: What about it?
records.en: What about it?

records.jp: なんか単純に、なんでカレーなのかなって。<CR>好きな食べ物だったとか？
records.en_original: I was just wondering why you decided on curry. Is it one of your favorites?
records.en_auxiliary: I was just wondering why you decided on curry. Is it one of your favorites?
records.en: I was just wondering why you decided on curry. Is it one of your favorites?

records.jp: カレー……
records.en_original: Curry...
records.en_auxiliary: Curry...
records.en: Curry...

records.jp: なんだか、無性に食べたくなったんだ
records.en_original: For some reason, I just really, really wanted to eat some.
records.en_auxiliary: For some reason, I just really, really wanted to eat some.
records.en: For some reason, I just really, really wanted to eat some.

records.jp: カレーは……そう、よくお母さんが作ってくれて――
records.en_original: My mom used to make it a lot—
records.en_auxiliary: My mom used to make it a lot—
records.en: Curry... Right, Mom used to make it for us all the time—

records.jp: この音は……！
records.en_original: That sound!
records.en_auxiliary: That sound!
records.en: That sound!

records.jp: 平原陽桜莉さんと平原美弦さんの<CR>ココロトープが接続されました
records.en_original: Hiori Hirahara and Mio Hirahara's Heartscape is now connected.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori Hirahara and Mio Hirahara's Heartscape is now connected.
records.en: Hirahara Hiori-san and Hirahara Mio-san's Heartscape is now connected.

records.jp: えっ……ココロトープが、二つ開いた……？
records.en_original: Two Heartscapes at once?
records.en_auxiliary: Two Heartscapes at once?
records.en: Two Heartscapes at once?

records.jp: ううん。おそらく、私とライムのココロトープと同じで<CR>二人で一つのココロトープになってる
records.en_original: No... I believe it is like Lime's and mine. Two people sharing the same Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: No... I believe it is like Lime's and mine. Two people sharing the same Heartscape.
records.en: No... I believe it is like Lime's and mine. Two people sharing the same Heartscape.

records.jp: 二人で長い時間を共に過ごしたりして想いが<CR>繋がっている場合、一つのココロトープになるみたい
records.en_original: I have come to believe that two Heartscapes may become one if the two in question spend a very long time together and are closely connected.
records.en_auxiliary: I have come to believe that two Heartscapes may become one if the two in question spend a very long time together and are closely connected.
records.en: I have come to believe that two Heartscapes may become one if the two in question spend a very long time together and are closely connected.

records.jp: 陽桜莉……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori...

records.jp: お姉ちゃん……？
records.en_original: Mio...?
records.en_auxiliary: Mio...?
records.en: Onee-chan...?

records.jp: どうしたの、陽桜莉さん？
records.en_original: What is it, Hiori?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it, Hiori?
records.en: What is it, Hiori-san?

records.jp: お姉ちゃんが、呼んでる気がする
records.en_original: I feel my sister calling to me.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel my sister calling to me.
records.en: I feel like Onee-chan is calling me.

records.jp: ねえ、そのココロトープ？　ってところに行けば、<CR>記憶を取り戻せるんだよね？
records.en_original: If we go to the Heartscape place, I can get my memories back, right?
records.en_auxiliary: If we go to the Heartscape place, I can get my memories back, right?
records.en: If we go to the Heartscape place, I can get my memories back, right?

records.jp: うん。今までと同じなら
records.en_original: Yes. If this follows the pattern.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. If this follows the pattern.
records.en: Yes. If this follows the pattern.

records.jp: どういうところなの？
records.en_original: What's it like?
records.en_auxiliary: What's it like?
records.en: What's it like?

records.jp: 入ってみないと分からないんだ。<CR>森だったり海辺だったり、人によって違う
records.en_original: We won't know until we go. We've seen forests and beaches, all kinds of things. It depends on the person.
records.en_auxiliary: We won't know until we go. We've seen forests and beaches, all kinds of things. It depends on the person.
records.en: We won't know until we go. We've seen forests and beaches, all kinds of things. It depends on the person.

records.jp: 思い出の中の景色だからね
records.en_original: They are created from the person's memories after all.
records.en_auxiliary: They are created from the person's memories after all.
records.en: They are created from the person's memories after all.

records.jp: ほへぇ～……
records.en_original: Whoa...
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa...
records.en: Whoa...

records.jp: けど、気をつけなくちゃいけないよ。<CR>モンスターっていう、危ないやつもいるから
records.en_original: But you'll have to be careful. There are dangerous creatures called demons there too.
records.en_auxiliary: But you'll have to be careful. There are dangerous creatures called demons there too.
records.en: But you'll have to be careful. There are dangerous creatures called demons there too.

records.jp: それでも行くよ。<CR>そこにお姉ちゃんがいる気がするんだ
records.en_original: I don't care what it takes, I want to go. My sister is there, I know it.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't care what it takes, I want to go. My sister is there, I know it.
records.en: Even so, I'm going. I feel like Onee-chan is there.

records.jp: それに、忘れちゃいけないことが、<CR>たくさんあったはずだから……
records.en_original: I know there are memories there that I never should have forgotten.
records.en_auxiliary: I know there are memories there that I never should have forgotten.
records.en: I know there are memories there that I never should have forgotten.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: わたしも、みんなもそうだった。<CR>協力して取り戻したんだよ
records.en_original: We've all gone through this. We'll get your memories back together.
records.en_auxiliary: We've all gone through this. We'll get your memories back together.
records.en: We've all gone through this. We'll get your memories back together.

records.jp: 頼んだぞ、探索班っ！
records.en_original: Good luck everyone!
records.en_auxiliary: Good luck everyone!
records.en: Good luck everyone!

records.jp: 頼んだぞ
records.en_original: Good luck.
records.en_auxiliary: Good luck.
records.en: Good luck.

records.jp: 任せて
records.en_original: Hehe, this'll be no problem.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, this'll be no problem.
records.en: Hehe, this'll be no problem.

records.jp: 一緒に行こう。ココロトープ
records.en_original: Let's do this together.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's do this together.
records.en: Let's do this together.

records.jp: よし、準備ができ次第二人のココロトープに行こう！
records.en_original: We'll head off to your Heartscape when we're all ready!
records.en_auxiliary: We'll head off to your Heartscape when we're all ready!
records.en: We'll head off to your Heartscape when we're all ready!

records.jp: リフレクターはあと二人！
records.en_original: Two more Reflectors left!
records.en_auxiliary: Two more Reflectors left!
records.en: Two more Reflectors left!

records.jp: 未合流のリフレクターはあと二人だよー！
records.en_original: You only need to find two more!
records.en_auxiliary: You only need to find two more!
records.en: You only need to find two more!

records.jp: さあ、ココロトープを攻略して記憶を取り戻して、<CR>リフレクターを探そう☆
records.en_original: Good luck searching that Heartscape for the remaining Reflectors and their memories!
records.en_auxiliary: Good luck searching that Heartscape for the remaining Reflectors and their memories!
records.en: Good luck searching that Heartscape for the remaining Reflectors and their memories!

records.jp: （なんでそんなことまで知ってるの……？）
records.en_original: (How does it know all of that?)
records.en_auxiliary: (How does it know all of that?)
records.en: (How does it know all of that?)

records.jp: やっぱり、おかしい……
records.en_original: Something is going on...
records.en_auxiliary: Something is going on...
records.en: Something is going on...
